reuse.why: Calls the shared assertBankAccountNotLinked, findOrCreateBank, syncAccount and handleSyncResponse, but the link body and the download function are copied from the Pluggy/Akahu versions rather than factored into a shared link or download helper.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount repeats the ~60-line upgrade-or-create/sync/notify body of the other provider link functions, and downloadFintegraTransactions repeats downloadAkahuTransactions almost line for line.

placement.why: The link handler sits with the other provider handlers in accounts/app.ts, the download and dispatch in accounts/sync.ts, the base path in server-config.ts and the account type in types/models.

scope.why: Only the Fintegra provider pieces and their tests are added.

maintainability.why: Consistent with the tree's copy-per-provider convention and easy to read, but adds a sixth copy of the link flow and another copy of the download function, so changes to linking must be repeated again.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The tree has no shared link-flow helper; the shared pre-link check assertBankAccountNotLinked is used.

disguised_duplication.where: linkFintegraAccount (accounts/app.ts) and downloadFintegraTransactions (accounts/sync.ts) are plain copies of the existing provider functions, not disguised.
